controlTower.intro: Design owner of the Agent Control Tower at OOCL — an agent platform for human decision support, agent execution, and human governance. Core capabilities are the agent lifecycle with queue-based dispatch, an advanced human-in-the-loop approval gate, dynamic workflow, dynamic dashboards, a knowledge base, and active alerts and notifications. The platform also includes a warm agent pool, a self-improvement pipeline, versioned agent definitions, live state tracking, multi-replica routing, durable task/thread state, an agent-pod registry, and a credential proxy.
controlTower.openSource: aria-conductor is the open-source proof of the Control Tower model: 10 Java modules, human-in-the-loop gates, agent chains, a concurrency harness, and API E2E coverage — a playground for scaling the platform and trying new features.

decomposer.body: Core designer of the job-decomposer library and heartbeat dispatch loop. At the framework level, a job is split recursively into tasks and sub-tasks across N levels and dispatched over asynchronous messaging. The heartbeat loop keeps dispatching, respects queue limits, applies backpressure, and scales workers from configuration or available resources. The design supports scalability, observability, stability, and robustness under load.

observability.body: Production observability on Rancher-managed Kubernetes. Owns the metrics, logs, cloud monitoring, and release checks for a platform of 30+ services, and uses the same signals to verify rollouts and investigate incidents.

projects.name: aria-conductor
projects.description: Java 21 + React 19 control tower for agent chains. Fixed a concurrent-approval race that allowed double approvals; built the load and concurrency harness.
projects.cvDescription: Designed and built a multi-service control tower: 10 Java modules, React 19/TypeScript dashboard, Node/TypeScript MCP server, MariaDB/H2, Docker/Podman, and per-agent OpenSandbox containers; API E2E coverage. Implemented governance and operator workflows: human review gates, versioned knowledge, BA→Dev→QA agent chains, live run status, kanban, and activity timeline. Fixed a concurrent-approval race where two opposing approvals could both pass the same pending check and commit; replaced read-check-write with an atomic conditional update, so one request wins and the other is rejected with an HTTP 409 conflict. Fixed a 500 that rolled back the whole transaction under mixed load; built the load and concurrency E2E harness plus Playwright UI coverage. Added an OpenCode/Qoder ACP bridge.
